tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Greek christos, 'Christ', + pherein, 'to bear' — 'bearer of Christ'. Its root is Greek christos + pherein. Saint Christopher, the patron of travellers. Christopher is a Greek name meaning “Bearer of Christ”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
